# Ontario Thriving Development Program (OTDP)

> OTDP is a student-led non-profit providing free, flexible tutoring, guidance and academic resources — online or in person — for every student across Ontario, Canada. No tuition, no entry tests, no catch. Founded 2026.

## About
- Free for every Ontario student — no cost, ever. Funded by partners and donations, not student fees.
- Delivered online or in person (in-person sessions are GTA-based; online tutoring and the resource library serve all of Ontario).
- Student-led: tutors come from IB, AP, SHSM, French Immersion, York Arts and mainstream high-school backgrounds.
- Governed by a Board under the 2026 OTDP Constitution.
- Subjects: math, sciences, English, French, social sciences and most Ontario high-school subjects.
- Signature feature: an end-of-semester project linking each subject to a real-world cause, with any funds raised donated to organisations addressing it.

## How to sign up
- Students sign up by email to otdp.org@gmail.com with the subject "Student sign-up — OTDP".
- Every "Sign up" button on the website opens a pre-filled Gmail draft using that template.
- Schools, community groups and prospective volunteers reach out to the same address.
